entities.summary: Tommy Johansson (b. 1987-10-26, Boden) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Boden and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
